## MaxTube tvOS release

- YouTube tvOS: `%yt_version%`
- MuTube revision: `%mutube_revision%`
- TizenTube userscript: `%tizentube_version%`
- Minimum tvOS: inherited from the YouTube base IPA

This build applies MuTube's version-specific Apple TV patches and loads a
pinned TizenTube userscript. The IPA must still be signed for your Apple TV.

MuTube does not publish a license. This private-repository build proceeds with
that known redistribution risk; see the third-party notices beside the IPA.
